mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the rise in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the drop in RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the rise in INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the sustained increase in PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and retail sales (RSAFS) are stagnant or declining, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS stagnant/declining
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of declining HOUST and stagnant/declining RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS < 1% does not correlate with subsequent easing actions by the Fed.
